release_note.en: FP16 bundle published and downloadable from Mac Models; native Mac demo passes automated checks. Listening and normal-screen acceptance pending.
release_note.ja: FP16のbundleを公開し、MacのModelsから取得できる。Macのネイティブデモは自動の確認に合格。試聴と通常の画面の本人受入は未完了。

note.en: Native Mac demo using the FP16 bundle from Models. Automated checks pass: Swift pipeline against Python-host records, production runtime smoke, Models import, Models-to-service generation and a fresh public download. Normal-screen use and listening await the owner's acceptance.
note.ja: ModelsのFP16のbundleを使うMacのネイティブデモ。自動の確認は合格: Pythonのホストの記録とのSwiftのパイプラインの照合、本番の実行部のsmoke、Modelsへの取込、Modelsからサービスでの生成、公開先からの新しい取得。通常の画面での操作と試聴は本人の受入待ち。

note.en: No native demo yet. Results of the Python host are not app support.
note.ja: ネイティブデモは未提供。Pythonのホストの結果はアプリの対応ではない。

conversion-20261117.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Python 3.11.9; torch 2.9.0; transformers 4.57.3; coreai-core 1.0.0b3; coreai-torch 0.4.3
conversion-20261117.backend: Python Core AI host, GPU-preferred specialization; compute units not profiled
conversion-20261117.route: VoxCPM2 recipe: original FP32 CPU reference -> component comparisons -> FP32 generation from text -> debug-information removal -> FP32 bundle re-check

workload.en: Five fixed sentences with seed 1708: 3,934 component comparisons that decide the result, FP32 generation from text with at most one replaced patch per sentence (3 of 239), and the same comparisons with the FP32 bundle after debug-information removal. No app; the Python host only.
workload.ja: 固定の5文・seed 1708。合否に使う部品の照合3,934件、文章からのFP32の生成(置き換えは各文1パッチ以下、239中3)、デバッグ情報を除いたFP32のbundleでの同じ照合。アプリではなくPythonのホストだけ。

precision-20261117.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Python 3.11.9; torch 2.9.0; transformers 4.57.3; coreai-core 1.0.0b3; coreai-torch 0.4.3
precision-20261117.backend: Python Core AI host, GPU-preferred specialization; compute units not profiled
precision-20261117.route: VoxCPM2 recipe synthesis_compare: exported assets, one worker process per generation

workload.en: Five sentences x seeds 1708-1710 per configuration, each timed after one warm-up generation in the same worker; load average 4.1-6.1. Recorded without a pass or fail. The bundles hold the same programs without debug information.
workload.ja: 構成ごとに5文×seed 1708〜1710。各生成は同じworkerでのwarm-up 1回の後に計時。load average 4.1〜6.1。合否なしの記録。bundleはデバッグ情報を除いた同じprogram。

memory-20261117.toolchain: Xcode 27.2 (27B52); Python 3.11.9; torch 2.9.0; transformers 4.57.3; coreai-core 1.0.0b3; coreai-torch 0.4.3
memory-20261117.backend: Python Core AI host, GPU-preferred specialization; compute units not profiled
memory-20261117.route: One new Python process per bundle: load -> one generation of long -> release, under the shared heavy-job lock
memory-20261117.artifact_revision: bundles of 20261116T204724-264d1994 (same main.mlirb and main.hash as the current fp32 and fp16 bundles)

workload.en: Sentence long (97 text tokens, 105 patches, 16.8 s of audio), seed 1708, first generation of the process. Process memory sampled before and after load, after the generation and after release by a one-off script outside the repository. Recorded without a pass or fail; not app memory.
workload.ja: 文long(97 token、105パッチ、音声16.8秒)、seed 1708、プロセスで最初の生成。ロードの前後、生成の後、解放の後にプロセスのメモリを、リポジトリの外の1回限りのスクリプトで採取。合否なしの記録で、アプリのメモリではない。

swift-pipeline-20261117.variant: FP32 for the comparisons; fp32, fp16 and fp16_proj32 for generation
swift-pipeline-20261117.route: VoxCPMNativeTests: per-call comparison with the recorded inputs, a pass fed with the recorded latent each patch, and free-running generation with seed 1708

workload.en: Five fixed sentences. FP32: all 3,590 per-call comparisons were bit-identical; with the recorded latent fed each patch, dit_hidden, stop logits and audio were bit-identical, the solver latent differed by at most 1.92e-5 and the stop patch matched for all five. Free-running results are recorded only. 15 generations across the three configurations had sample counts equal to patches x 7680 and no non-finite values. Swift package tests, not the app.
workload.ja: 固定の5文。FP32で、呼び出しごとの照合3,590件はすべてビット一致。記録の潜在を毎パッチ与えた通しは、dit_hidden・停止のlogits・音声がビット一致、解法の潜在の差は最大1.92e-5、停止したパッチは5文とも一致。自走の結果は記録だけ。3構成の15回の生成で、標本数はパッチ数×7680と合い、非有限値なし。Swiftのパッケージの試験で、アプリではない。

runtime-smoke-20261117.route: VoxCPMRuntimeNativeTests: open -> generate -> generate another sentence -> release -> generate the same sentence -> release

workload.en: Seed 1708; sentences with 2.40 s and 5.44 s of audio. All three configurations passed; assets were loaded the first time and again after release; process RSS before -> after release was 16.49 -> 0.21 GB (fp32), 8.35 -> 0.20 GB (fp16) and 8.42 -> 0.21 GB (fp16_proj32); the regenerated WAV equaled the first byte for byte. Swift package tests in release, not the app.
workload.ja: seed 1708。音声2.40秒と5.44秒の文。3構成とも合格。資産の読み込みは初回と解放の後。解放の前→後のプロセスのRSSは、fp32で16.49→0.21 GB、fp16で8.35→0.20 GB、fp16_proj32で8.42→0.21 GB。読み直した後のWAVは最初の生成とバイト単位で同じ。releaseのSwiftのパッケージの試験で、アプリではない。

models-import-20261117.variant: All-FP16 bundle; two other configurations only as rejected inputs
models-import-20261117.route: VoxCPMImportTests.knownBundle: import of the real bundle into Models (copy, full inspection, ready, deletion refused while in use, deletion after release, rejection of other configurations and four damaged copies); then VoxCPMRuntimeNativeTests with the new verified-copy key

workload.en: 22 files, 4,677,413,664 B: copy 1.7-2.4 s, promotion 1.5-1.7 s, full re-inspection 1.5-1.7 s; source hashes unchanged; deletion refused while leased. After the verified-copy key change, open -> generate -> release -> regenerate passed with byte-identical audio (fp16 only). Swift package tests, not the app.
workload.ja: 22ファイル・4,677,413,664 B。コピー1.7〜2.4秒、昇格1.5〜1.7秒、全量の再検査1.5〜1.7秒。元のhashは不変。lease中の削除は拒否。検査済みの複製の鍵を変えた後、開く→生成→解放→再生成が合格し、音声はバイト単位で同じ(fp16だけ)。Swiftのパッケージの試験で、アプリではない。

mac-models-20261117.route: VoxCPMMacIntegrationTests: import into a temporary Models area -> usage lease -> open through the same store path as the screen -> three examples -> stop -> lease return

workload.en: Import of 22 files, 4,677,413,664 B in 3.62 s; open with the full hash check 1.83 s; three examples: 2.40 s of audio in 6.42 s including asset load, 5.44 s in 1.51 s and 5.28 s in 1.49 s; 48 kHz mono Float32 WAV; leases 0 -> 1 -> 1 -> 0; source hashes unchanged. Swift package tests in release, not the app GUI; no playback or listening.
workload.ja: 22ファイル・4,677,413,664 Bの取込は3.62秒、全hashの検査を含む開くは1.83秒。例文3つで、資産の読み込みを含む6.42秒で2.40秒の音声、1.51秒で5.44秒、1.49秒で5.28秒。WAVは48 kHz・mono・Float32。leaseは0→1→1→0。元のhashは不変。releaseのSwiftのパッケージの試験で、アプリの画面ではなく、再生も試聴もしていない。

download-20261118.backend: Swift Core AI, GPU preference; actual delegate not profiled
download-20261118.route: Fresh Models download without credentials from the pinned revision into a temporary model library -> full inspection -> usage lease -> production speech store and service -> one example -> stop -> lease release -> deletion

workload.en: 22 GETs with no header fields from okayuji/voxcpm2-coreai fp16/, all HTTP 200, 4,677,413,664 B into a new temporary model library with no migration candidates; download 145.8 s and validation 1.52 s (network-dependent, not a performance measurement); one example: 2.40 s of audio in 5.40 s including asset load; leases 0 -> 1 -> 1 -> 0; then deleted. No app GUI, playback or listening.
workload.ja: okayuji/voxcpm2-coreaiのfp16/へのheaderの無い22件の取得がすべてHTTP 200で、4,677,413,664 Bを移行候補の無い新しい一時のモデルの領域へ取得。ダウンロード145.8秒・検査1.52秒(通信に依存し、性能の計測ではない)。例文1つで、資産の読み込みを含む5.40秒で2.40秒の音声。leaseは0→1→1→0、その後に削除。アプリの画面・再生・試聴はしていない。

note.en: fp32 bundle: 22 files, including the manifest, tokenizer, license and notice.
note.ja: fp32のbundle。manifest・tokenizer・license・noticeを含む22ファイル。

note.en: fp16 bundle: 22 files. FP16 results are recorded only.
note.ja: fp16のbundle。22ファイル。FP16の結果は記録だけ。

note.en: fp16_proj32 bundle (FP16 with proj in FP32): 22 files. FP16 results are recorded only.
note.ja: fp16_proj32のbundle(projだけFP32)。22ファイル。FP16の結果は記録だけ。

note.en: Largest FP32 component error (max abs error / max abs reference), dit.main; proj.fuse is judged by classes instead (233 match, 1 boundary-consistent, 0 fail). n counts dit.main calls.
note.ja: FP32の部品の最大誤差(最大絶対誤差/参照の最大絶対値)、dit.main。proj.fuseは分類で判定(一致233・境界整合1・不合格0)。nはdit.mainの呼び出し数。

note.en: fp32: generation seconds per second of audio, after one warm-up; excludes loading and saving.
note.ja: fp32。音声1秒あたりの生成秒数。warm-up 1回の後。ロードと保存を除く。

note.en: fp16: as above. Audio follows a different trajectory from FP32; listening pending.
note.ja: fp16。同上。FP32と別の軌道の音声。試聴は未完了。

note.en: fp16_proj32: as above. Audio follows a different trajectory from FP32; listening pending.
note.ja: fp16_proj32。同上。FP32と別の軌道の音声。試聴は未完了。

note.en: fp32: one generation of long (16.8 s of audio) as the first of a new process; excludes the 7.07 s load.
note.ja: fp32。新しいプロセスで最初のlongの生成(音声16.8秒)。7.07秒のロードを除く。

note.en: fp16: one generation of long (16.8 s of audio) as the first of a new process; excludes the 3.40 s load.
note.ja: fp16。新しいプロセスで最初のlongの生成(音声16.8秒)。3.40秒のロードを除く。

note.en: fp32: process lifetime maximum resident size (getrusage), including file-backed weight pages. Python host, not app memory.
note.ja: fp32。プロセスの生涯の最大常駐(getrusage)。ファイルにmapした重みのページを含む。Pythonのホストで、アプリのメモリではない。

note.en: fp16: process lifetime maximum resident size (getrusage). Python host, not app memory.
note.ja: fp16。プロセスの生涯の最大常駐(getrusage)。Pythonのホストで、アプリのメモリではない。

note.en: fp32: kernel lifetime maximum physical footprint of the process. Python host, not app memory.
note.ja: fp32。カーネルが記録したプロセスの生涯の最大physical footprint。Pythonのホストで、アプリのメモリではない。

note.en: fp16: kernel lifetime maximum physical footprint of the process. Python host, not app memory.
note.ja: fp16。カーネルが記録したプロセスの生涯の最大physical footprint。Pythonのホストで、アプリのメモリではない。

note.en: fp32: resident size sampled after the generation with the assets still loaded.
note.ja: fp32。資産を保持したまま生成の後に採取した常駐サイズ。

note.en: fp16: resident size sampled after the generation with the assets still loaded.
note.ja: fp16。資産を保持したまま生成の後に採取した常駐サイズ。

note.en: fp32: physical footprint after closing the components minus before loading. System wired memory had not fallen at that sample (see evidence).
note.ja: fp32。部品を閉じた後のphysical footprintからロード前を引いた値。その時点でシステムのwiredは減っていない(根拠を参照)。

note.en: fp16: physical footprint after closing the components minus before loading. System wired memory had not fallen at that sample (see evidence).
note.ja: fp16。部品を閉じた後のphysical footprintからロード前を引いた値。その時点でシステムのwiredは減っていない(根拠を参照)。

reason.en: Not measured; the size of the specialization cache was not recorded.
reason.ja: 未計測。特殊化のcacheの大きさは記録していない。

reason.en: Not measured as defined: the load times of the memory runs (fp32 7.07 s, fp16 3.40 s) did not control the specialization cache.
reason.ja: 定義どおりには未計測。メモリの計測のロード時間(fp32 7.07秒、fp16 3.40秒)は特殊化のcacheの状態を制御していない。

reason.en: Not measured as defined: the load times of the memory runs did not control the specialization cache.
reason.ja: 定義どおりには未計測。メモリの計測のロード時間は特殊化のcacheの状態を制御していない。

reason.en: Not measured; no task-quality evaluation set.
reason.ja: 未計測。用途の品質の評価セットはない。

reason.en: Not measured as defined: only one stop after generation, while the model was idle, was timed (download check); a stop during generation was not measured.
reason.ja: 定義どおりには未計測。生成の後の待機中の停止を1回だけ測った(ダウンロードの確認)。生成の途中の停止は測っていない。

reason.en: Not measured. Neither the Python host nor the app streams audio; the app returns the audio after the whole generation.
reason.ja: 未計測。Pythonのホストもアプリも逐次に再生せず、アプリは生成の全体が終わってから音声を返す。

reason.en: Not measured; no speech recognition evaluation.
reason.ja: 未計測。音声認識による評価はしていない。

reason.en: Not measured; no listening comparison has been done.
reason.ja: 未計測。聴き比べは未実施。

note.en: FP32 components, FP32 generation from text of five sentences with three replaced patches, and the FP32 bundle re-check pass. FP16 is recorded only; listening is pending.
note.ja: FP32の部品、置き換え3パッチでの5文のFP32の生成、FP32のbundleの再照合が合格。FP16は記録だけ。試聴は未完了。

note.en: No quality evaluation; the default configuration will be chosen after a listening comparison.
note.ja: 品質の評価は未実施。既定の構成は聴き比べの後に決める。

note.en: Release and reload with the real model were checked in the runtime (#590). The Models service check (#592) only ended use after generating and returned the lease. Continuous use in the app is not measured.
note.ja: 実モデルでの解放と読み直しは実行部で確認した(#590)。Modelsのサービスの通し(#592)は、生成の後に利用を終えてleaseを返しただけ。アプリでの連続利用は未計測。

note.en: Cancellation and retry are covered by CPU fakes (#590). With the real model, only a stop after generation and the lease return were checked (#592); cancelling a running generation was not checked.
note.ja: 取消と再試行は偽の部品のCPUの試験で確認(#590)。実モデルでは、生成の後の停止とleaseの返却だけを確認した(#592)。実行中の生成の取消は確かめていない。
